sources.title: U-Net - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: U-Net turned out to be an ideal architecture for this denoising task for several reasons. The encoder-decoder structure allows the model to process the image at multiple scales, capturing both global composition and local details. The skip connections preserve the fine spatial information needed to produce sharp, detailed images.
